Thicken the shaft into a filled band and make the whorl a clear filled disc or ring centred on star 80331, sized visibly larger than the shaft width. Widen the hook into a visible open curl at 83895. Draw the yarn as a bolder arc leaving the whorl rim, peaking at star 77277 and descending to star 75458, in a contrasting stroke. Stop the blue outline from duplicating the gold shaft. Shorten the labels or set them outside the figure with leader lines so none are clipped or run through the whorl and yarn.
